global_guards.name: exact_recovery_binding
global_guards.expression: spacecraft_id, recovery_id, epoch, counter, transcript, authority, and candidate fields match the pending or receipt record

global_guards.name: no_hidden_peer_oracle
global_guards.expression: ground target proposal uses ground state and recovery-authority epoch floor only

B0.action: stage uploaded session key; attacker learns it if the protecting master key is compromised
activate uploaded session key and increment epoch

B1.action: stage transcript-bound candidate; do not activate operational SDLS state
activate the ground candidate without using simulator-wide knowledge of responder receipt
activate the spacecraft candidate after validating KEM_CONFIRM
activate spacecraft candidate and send the explicit fourth integration message
activate ground candidate after receiving authenticated status
expire both candidates and retain SYNC(previous_epoch)
record S_AHEAD and DIVERGED; do not treat status delivery as an oracle
abort or expire the exchange; no protocol-layer reordering or retransmission is assumed

B2.action: mark only the current output traffic key attacker-known
mark ground sender state exposed without automatically marking future keys known
mark spacecraft receiver state exposed and future aligned keys traceable
advance spacecraft on an attacker-known branch and record S_AHEAD and LOCKED
ground sender derives the new key, evolves sender state, and deletes prior sender state
spacecraft receiver derives the matching key, evolves receiver state, and deletes prior receiver state
mark the new aligned key attacker-known and classify availability as unsafe
record G_AHEAD and LOCKED because the strict baseline retains no prior sender state or recovery checkpoint
leave endpoints cryptographically synchronized but mark recovery verification INDETERMINATE
restore ground to an older epoch and record S_AHEAD and LOCKED

T1_PROVISIONAL.action: ground reserves one bounded attempt and proposes max(ground epoch, authority floor)+1; no candidate activates
spacecraft selects max(proposed epoch, local epoch+1), stages one candidate, and returns RECOVERY_RESPONSE
return the same selected candidate without allocating another pending state
ground stages the exact selected candidate and emits RECOVERY_COMMIT
spacecraft activates the candidate once and stores one bounded activation receipt
re-emit RECOVERY_CONFIRM from the activation receipt without a second activation
ground activates the exact candidate and advances the recovery-authority epoch floor

guards: ground active state == spacecraft active state
T1_PROVISIONAL.action: accept a fresh test command, receive authenticated status, mark both endpoints VERIFIED, and permit SUCCESS
clear bounded candidates, retain prior operational states, and classify EXPIRED
clear bounded attempt records and classify SECURE_DEGRADED rather than permanent LOCKED

guards: not G-005 or not G-011 or not G-012
